parsed.scene_description: A wide-angle view of a dimly lit warehouse aisle flanked by tall metal racks filled with stacked crates and pallets. A red forklift is partially visible near the center. The floor is concrete, and stacks of wooden pallets are on the right. Lighting comes from overhead fixtures, creating shadows and highlighting industrial materials.

objects.label: metal shelving unit
objects.observation: Tall blue metal shelving unit on the left, holding multiple rows of blue plastic crates and wooden crates. Partially obstructed by other objects. Appears freestanding. Supports stacked cargo. Contacts ground at base. Located in foreground-left.

objects.label: wooden pallet stack
objects.observation: Stack of weathered wooden pallets on the right side of the aisle. Multiple layers, some showing wear. Positioned against wall. Contacts ground. Not obscured. Located in mid-right.

objects.label: red forklift
objects.observation: Red forklift partially visible behind shelving unit, near center. Only rear section and part of cab seen. Appears stationary. Contacts ground. Occluded by shelves. Located behind central rack.

objects.label: blue plastic crates
objects.observation: Rows of blue plastic crates stacked high on left shelving unit. Uniform shape, some labeled. Visible under lighting. Occluded by shelves. Contacts shelves. Located in upper-left quadrant.

objects.label: wooden crate
objects.observation: Large wooden crate on top shelf of left shelving unit. Has white label. Partially visible. Contacts shelf above. Occluded by other crates. Located upper-left.

objects.label: yellow-and-black safety cone
objects.observation: Yellow-and-black striped safety cone on floor near base of shelving unit. Base on ground. Contacts floor. Located in lower-center-left.
